overview: Information Security Education and Awareness (ISEA) is an initiative of the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India, aimed at generating human resources in Information Security and creating general awareness on Cyber Hygiene/Cyber Security among the masses. The project, started in 2005 and currently in its third phase since October 2023, focuses on four key verticals: generating highly skilled and certified cybersecurity professionals (CISOs), grooming students towards product and solution development, strengthening research and education in emerging areas of Information Security, and developing cyber-aware Digital Naagriks (mass awareness). It is implemented through 50 premier academic institutions in a hub-and-spoke model, supported by common infrastructure and shared resources via the ISEA Virtual Platform (IVP).
objectives: Generate highly skilled and certified cybersecurity professionals (CISOs, Dy. CISOs, Associate team of CISOs/Aspirants)
Groom students towards products and solutions development in cybersecurity
Strengthen research and education in advanced and emerging areas of Information Security
Develop cyber-aware Digital Naagriks through mass awareness on cyber hygiene and cyber security
Provide training to government officials in information security
Organize awareness workshops and programs for various stakeholders including school/college students, teachers, government personnel, LEAs, parents, and women
Support research manpower (Post-docs, MS by Research, SRF/JRF, RA, Young Fellows, etc.) and domain-specific lab development
Promote multi-disciplinary education by introducing cyber security education at UG level
Facilitate knowledge creation and dissemination through paper publications, patents, national/international conferences, and expert lectures
Enable internships, MOOC courses, faculty development programs, and standardized curriculum development
eligibility: Eligibility varies by vertical: For CISO training and certification, professionals seeking specialization in 13 domains of knowledge and skilling are eligible; for student grooming, students from 50 participating Lead & Co-Lead institutes and affiliated colleges can participate in Bootcamps, Hackathons, and Innovation Challenges; for research and education, faculty, professionals, Post-docs, MS/PhD scholars, and research personnel in niche areas of Information Security are eligible; for mass awareness, general users, students, teachers, government personnel, LEAs, parents, women, and senior citizens can participate in awareness programs, workshops, and online quiz competitions.
benefits: Participants gain access to training and certification programs (including CISO), skill development in 10 thematic areas of cybersecurity, opportunities to innovate through Bootcamps, Hackathons, and Innovation Challenges, access to standardized curricula, specialized M.Tech programs, MOOC courses, faculty development programs, internships, research support (Post-docs, SRF/JRF, etc.), domain-specific lab setup, paper publication and patent filing support, participation in national/international conferences and expert lectures, access to cybersecurity exercise platforms, sandboxing environments, IT-OT simulation platforms, and centralized data repositories via ISEA-Cloud and ISEA Virtual Platform (IVP), and mass awareness through awareness weeks, workshops, online quizzes, and multilingual awareness material (handbooks, newsletters, videos, posters, cartoon stories) disseminated through print, electronics, social media, and staysafeonline.in.
financial_support: The ISEA Project is funded by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India. ISEA Phase II was approved with an outlay of Rs. 96.08 crore for implementation over 5 years w.e.f. 01.04.2014. Financial support under the scheme includes funding for training programs, research manpower (Post-docs, MS by Research, SRF/JRF, RA, Young Fellows), setting up domain-specific labs, faculty build-up, research paper publications, patent filing, national and international conferences, expert lectures, development of standardized curriculum, specialized M.Tech programs, MOOC courses, faculty development programs, internships, and mass awareness activities including awareness weeks, workshops, online quiz competitions, and production and dissemination of multilingual awareness material.
application_process: 1. Visit the ISEA website at https://isea.gov.in 2. Navigate to the relevant vertical section (e.g., Grooming Students, Research & Education, CISO Training & Certification, or Mass Awareness) 3. Select the specific program of interest (e.g., Bootcamp, Hackathon, Innovation Challenge, MOOC, Internship, or Awareness Workshop) 4. Click on 'Register now' for the chosen program 5. Fill in the registration form with required details 6. Submit the form and await confirmation 7. Upon approval, access the program via the ISEA Virtual Platform (IVP) 8. Participate in the scheduled activities (online or at designated institutes) 9. Complete assessments or project work as required 10. Receive certification or recognition upon successful completion.
deadlines: Rolling basis — programs such as Bootcamps, Hackathons, Innovation Challenges, MOOCs, internships, and awareness workshops have specific start and end dates as per the event calendar; admissions are open until seats are filled or as per the schedule announced on the website.
implementing_agency: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India
contact_details: Email: isea[at]cdac[dot]in (Academic Activities), isea-ciso[at]cdac[dot]in (CISOs Training & Certification), isea[at]cdac[dot]in (Awareness Activities), support-ivp[at]cdac[dot]in (ISEA Virtual Platform support)
caveats: Training and certification programs are conducted through select 50 premier academic institutions in a hub-and-spoke model
Access to certain resources and programs may be restricted to participants from affiliated institutes or enrolled candidates
Some programs (e.g., specialized M.Tech, research support) may have additional eligibility criteria based on academic qualifications
Mass awareness programs are conducted in collaboration with State Cyber Cell/Police departments and may be limited to select cities
The ISEA Virtual Platform (IVP) requires internet connectivity and compatible devices for access
Certain awareness material is available for download only via https://staysafeonline.in/
Program schedules and availability are subject to change; users must check the website for updated event calendars
